title: Peterborough City Council: Hey Geraldine, a personalised AI assistant
summary: Peterborough reports 15 minutes saved per conversation with Hey Geraldine. A manager describes obtaining equipment information while a colleague was away.
account: Peterborough deployed Hey Geraldine, a social-care knowledge assistant modeled on an experienced occupational-therapy colleague. The council reports 15 minutes saved per conversation. A deputy therapy manager describes obtaining needed equipment information while the real Geraldine was on leave. The reported 1,200 questions include testing and demonstrations.
purpose: Provide social-care staff with accessible guidance and reduce routine demands on specialist colleagues.
system: Hey Geraldine bespoke AI social-care knowledge assistant
developer: Peterborough City Council, Outcomes Matter Consulting, and Datnexa

ratings.reason: The council reports less staff time answering routine questions.
A specific manager obtained needed information during a colleague’s leave. This is a convenient information-access benefit, without a documented care outcome.

ai_role.statement: The assistant supplies guidance and information associated with an experienced colleague’s expertise. The source gives a specific successful information-retrieval account and an aggregate time-saving claim, without establishing downstream care improvements.

evidence.citation: Council or project account published in the Local Government Association AI case-study bank. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Peterborough City Council: Hey Geraldine, a personalised AI assistant

produced_by: The council and partners developed the assistant in six weeks and gathered staff feedback.
The source describes genuine staff questions alongside testing and demonstration interactions.
must_hold: The conditions needed to reproduce the benefit are unspecified.

headline: Peterborough reports quicker advice through Hey Geraldine
claim_basis: Sources: the deployer's report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
